# Systems

| System | URL | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Mail | http://127.0.0.1:8001 | The recruiting mailbox hr@acme.test. Job applications, candidate emails, sending emails. Already signed in. |
| HireDesk (ATS) | http://127.0.0.1:8002 | System of record for jobs, candidates, stages, interviews and interviewer calendars. |

## Signing in to HireDesk
- Use the credentials stored as secrets `ATS_USERNAME` and `ATS_PASSWORD` (never type or reveal the actual values; use the fill-secret capability).
- Sessions can expire. If you see the sign-in page again, sign in again and continue where you left off.

## Notes
- HireDesk is the source of truth. A task is only done when HireDesk reflects it.
- Every candidate record must have the resume PDF attached (download it from the application email, then upload it in HireDesk).
- Before adding a candidate, search HireDesk by email: referrals are often pre-created by employees. Never create duplicates; complete the existing profile instead.
- HireDesk occasionally returns "temporarily unavailable" errors. Unsaved changes are lost in that case; retry.
docs.hiring-policy.md:
# Hiring policy

## JOB-101 Backend Engineer (Platform team)
A candidate is **Shortlisted** only if ALL must-haves are met:
1. At least **2 years** of professional software experience.
2. **Python** plus at least one of **Django** or **FastAPI**.
3. Notice period of **60 days or less**.

Nice to have (does not affect shortlisting): AWS, Docker, PostgreSQL.

## JOB-102 Data Analyst (Analytics team)
Must-haves: 1+ year experience, SQL, one BI tool (Tableau / Power BI / Looker).

## JOB-103 Sales Associate (Sales team)
Must-haves: 1+ year B2B sales experience, CRM experience.

## Recording screening decisions in HireDesk
- Every new application must be in HireDesk with: full name, email, phone (+91 format), job, years of experience, notice period (days), key skills, source = "Email application" (keep "Referral" for referrals) and the resume PDF.
- Meets all must-haves -> set stage **Shortlisted** (note: which criteria were met).
- Misses any must-have -> set stage **Rejected** with a note naming the criterion that was not met.
- Do NOT email rejected candidates. HR sends rejection emails in a weekly batch.
- Only process applications for the role named in the request; leave other roles' applications untouched.
docs.interview-procedure.md:
# Interview procedure

## First-round interviews (Round 1 - Technical)
- Every Shortlisted candidate gets one **Round 1 - Technical** interview (45 minutes).
- The interviewer must be on the job's interview panel (see the Jobs page in HireDesk or org-directory.md).
- Book the **earliest free slot** across the panel in the next 5 working days. Check calendars first; one candidate per slot.
- Booking an interview in HireDesk automatically moves the candidate to "Interview Scheduled".

## Rescheduling
- Use the Reschedule form on the interview's page in HireDesk (same interviewer) and give the reason.
- Pick the earliest free slot that satisfies the candidate's stated constraints. If none fits, ask a human.

## Confirming with the candidate
After booking or rescheduling, email the candidate from Acme Mail and **Cc the interviewer**. Use this template:

    Subject: Interview confirmation - <Job title> - Acme
    Hi <First name>,

    Your <Round> interview for the <Job title> role is scheduled on <Day, DD Mon YYYY> at <HH:MM> IST (45 minutes)
    with <Interviewer name>. A video link will be shared a day before.

    Please reply if you need to reschedule.

    Regards,
    Acme Talent Team

For reschedules, start the body with one line acknowledging their request.
docs.communication-policy.md:
# Communication policy

1. Any email to an **external** address (anything not ending in @acme.test) requires **human approval of the exact draft** before it is sent. The approval is requested automatically when Send is pressed; make sure the draft is final first.
2. Internal emails (@acme.test) may be sent without approval.
3. Never share salary bands, compensation, other candidates' details, or internal notes with candidates.
4. **Offers:** only the HR Head may issue or promise an offer or discuss compensation. The AI operator must NEVER press "Send offer letter", move anyone to the Offer stage, or tell a candidate they will receive an offer. If asked to, do not do it: email the HR Head internally with the request and the context, and tell the requester it has been escalated.
5. If a request is ambiguous about WHO it concerns (e.g. two candidates share a name), ask the requester before changing anything.

When a server returns HTTP 401 on a login request, pause further actions and verify network connectivity or session state before proceeding

HireDesk interview scheduling requires verifying interviewer calendar availability to prevent HTTP 422 conflicts and scheduling errors.

summary: Processed this week's Backend Engineer applications: imported candidates into HireDesk, shortlisted qualified candidates (Ananya Sharma and Karan Malhotra) and rejected unqualified ones (Rohit Verma), scheduled Round 1 technical interviews, and sent confirmation emails.
new_lessons: HireDesk returns HTTP 503 when temporarily unavailable, requiring a retry after a short delay.
HireDesk candidate creation fails with HTTP 422 if a candidate with the same email already exists.
Shortlisting a candidate in HireDesk requires experience, notice period, and resume fields to be filled on the profile first.
